theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_sp_cube_geometry
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → Convex ℝ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ∧ MeasurableSet {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ∧ (∀ x ∈ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∀ y ∈ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖x - y‖ ≤ Real.sqrt n) ∧ volume {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ≤ 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
